args.description: 2D side-view beat 'em up stage background, Streets of Rage 2 pixel art, strictly flat orthographic side view, the camera looks straight at the wall with NO perspective and no vanishing point, no text, no letters, no logos, no people. Inside the grand historic waiting hall of Kievsky railway station in Moscow: tall arched windows with white stone frames, cream and pale yellow walls with ornate stucco cornices, a large dark blank electronic departures board high on the wall, bronze chandeliers hanging from the top edge, a row of dark wooden waiting benches against the wall. Floor: polished beige and grey granite tiles. Overcast bright daylight through a glass roof, muted realistic colors matched to the neighbouring screen. Bottom 45% of the image: wide empty walkable floor, the base of the wall meets the floor in one straight horizontal line, nothing standing on the floor.
